help.title: Help
help.askQuestion: 💬 Ask how to use this app
help.askPrompt: Ask me how to use any part of this app — for example "how do I save a scheme?"
help.askPlaceholder: Ask a question about using the app...

accessibility.simpleModeDesc: Fewer options, bigger buttons, less text — good for a first visit.
accessibility.signAnimationDesc: Shows a simple animated hand alongside captions while a page is read aloud, as a visual cue for deaf and hard-of-hearing users. Not full sign-language translation.
accessibility.signInputDesc: Recognizes a small set of hand signs (yes / no) from your camera to answer simple questions. Experimental — accuracy is limited, and it never replaces typing or speaking.
accessibility.signInputCameraError: Could not access the camera. You can still answer by tapping.

welcome.title: Benefits Navigator
welcome.tagline: Find government welfare schemes you may be eligible for — explained clearly, in your language.
welcome.description: This app helps you discover central and state government schemes, understand exactly why you do or don't qualify, and prepare the right documents — all for free, with no account required to get started.
welcome.continueAsGuest: You can explore freely as a guest — signing in is optional and only adds syncing across your devices.

home.headline: Find Government Benefits You May Be Eligible For
home.subheadline: Tell us about your situation. We'll help you discover relevant government schemes, understand the eligibility requirements, prepare your documents, and find the official application process.
home.trust1: Every scheme links to its official government source.
home.trust2: Eligibility is checked with transparent, explainable rules — never a guess.
home.trust3: We never ask for Aadhaar, passwords, OTPs, or bank details.
home.trust4: Final eligibility is always determined by the relevant government authority.

chat.welcome: Hi! Tell me a bit about your situation — for example your age, state, occupation, and income — and I'll help you find relevant government schemes.
chat.placeholder: Type your question... e.g. I am a 20 year old student from Tamil Nadu
chat.noRecommendationsDesc: Describe your situation in the chat — your age, state, occupation, and income help us find relevant schemes.

voice.errorNoSpeech: We didn't hear anything. Try speaking closer to the microphone.
voice.errorNoMic: No microphone was found. Please type instead.
voice.errorLanguageNotSupported: This language isn't supported for voice input in your browser yet.
voice.errorNetwork: A network error interrupted voice input. Please try again.
voice.errorGeneric: Voice input error. Please try again or type instead.
voice.errorDidntCatch: We didn't catch that. Please try again or type instead.
voice.errorNotSupportedBrowser: Voice input is not supported in this browser. Please type instead.
voice.errorInsecureContext: Voice input needs a secure (https) connection. Please type instead.
voice.errorCouldNotStart: Could not start voice input. Please try again.

profileForm.intro: We only ask for what's needed to match you with benefits. No Aadhaar, bank details, or passwords are ever required.
profileForm.fillWithAiPrompt: Describe yourself in a sentence or two — typed or spoken — and we'll fill in what we can below for you to review.
profileForm.fillWithAiPlaceholder: e.g. I am a 45 year old farmer from Tamil Nadu with 2 acres of land...
profileForm.fillWithAiFilled: Filled {{count}} field(s) — please check them below before submitting.

benefits.noMatchDesc: Try adding more information to your profile, browsing another category, or asking the AI directly.
